description_en: Removes tags from specified VPC peering connections
description_zh: 调用UnTagResources接口为指定的VPC对等连接统一解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun vpcpeer un-tag-resources --resource-id '["pcc-bp16qjewdsunr41m1****"]' --resource-type PeerConnection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnTagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource. You can specify up to 20 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。最多支持解绑20个资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The tag key that you want to remove. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. If you need to pass this parameter, you can enter an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要解绑的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。


最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resource. Valid values:
true: Removes all tags from the resource.
false (default): Does not remove all tags from the resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源的所有标签。取值：
true：解除资源的所有标签。
false（默认值）：不解除资源的所有标签
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Valid value: PeerConnection, which indicates a VPC peering connection
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。取值：PeerConnection，VPC对等连接
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the token value on your client and ensure that it is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the tag resides. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
标签所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the unbinding was successful. Valid values:

true: The creation and binding were successful.
false: The creation and binding failed
Success.description_zh:
是否解绑成功。取值：

true：创建并绑定成功。
false：创建并绑定失败
